correctness.rationale: For all t>0 and all positive independent edge conductances, two explicitly given mass-mean-zero vectors have exactly equal energy s^2(w1+w3)+4w2 and mass norms 4s(s+1), 4s(s-1), where s=sqrt(1+t). Rayleigh--Ritz proves the global lower ratio. At the proposed weights, all four generalized eigenvectors and ordered eigenvalues are checked algebraically. Equality in the lower Rayleigh bound forces w1=w3 and w2=(1+t)w1/2. Included checker validates exact symbolic identities and 155 supplementary numerical cases. Numerical sampling is not relied upon for the theorem.

value.rationale: A four-site reflected chain is the smallest mirror-symmetric path with a distinct central designable edge and independent interior/endpoint mass classes. The exact global minimizer across three free conductances changes from center weaker to center stronger precisely as the mass ratio crosses one; it gives a sharp condition number and an all-weight common-energy certificate. This directly addresses heterogeneous-capacitance diffusion and mass-normalized iterative coupling, rather than an arbitrary tabulation or minor numerical improvement.
